svg.title: DynOLAT OLAT video prediction pipeline, reconstructed from Figure 2
svg.desc: A flat-lit input video is encoded to latent features. Spherical harmonics of individual target light directions condition an iterative bridge matching video model. A frozen decoder produces OLAT videos, which are recomposed in linear color space with environment-map weights to generate relit videos.

g.text: Reconstructed from paper Fig. 2 · flat-lit sequence → direction-specific light responses → linear environment assembly
one response for each requested direction
Frozen encoder / decoder · direction-specific OLAT basis videos · environment-map weights control the recomposition
